_readme: Caption style presets. Each one adjusts the look's caption: karaoke (the spoken word lights up in the accent colour), scale (size), upper (capital letters), box ('chunk': a dark pill behind the words, 'word': the spoken word sits in an accent box), pop (how much the spoken word grows), entitySerif (names and foreign words in the serif face), offsetY (move the line down (+) or up (-), as a fraction of the height). Captions always stay inside the platform safe zone and graphics always stay off them.

classic.label: Classic
classic.description: The spoken word lights up; names in serif italics.

bold.label: Bold
bold.description: Big capital letters with the spoken word lit.

boxed.label: Boxed
boxed.description: White words on a dark pill, readable on any footage.

highlight.label: Highlight
highlight.description: The spoken word sits in an accent box.

pop.label: Pop
pop.description: The spoken word grows and lights up.
